Unbiased Inverse Volume Rendering with Differential Trackers
This repository contains code examples to reproduce the results from the article: Merlin Nimier-David, Thomas Müller, Alexander Keller, and Wenzel Jakob. 2022. Unbiased Inverse Volume Rendering with Differential Trackers. In Transactions on Graphics (Proceedings of SIGGRAPH) 41 (4). It uses the Mitsuba 3 differentiable renderer.
